abstract: Background Dermoid cysts, or mature cystic teratomas, are the most common benign ovarian neoplasms in women of reproductive age and are frequently encountered during pregnancy. Their management poses unique challenges, requiring a balance between maternal-fetal safety and risks of surgery. Evidence from Indian tertiary care centers remains limited. This study aimed to evaluate the clinical profile, management strategies, and maternal-fetal outcomes of dermoid cysts in pregnancy. Methods This retrospective observational study included 87 pregnant women diagnosed with dermoid cysts over six years at Maharaja Agrasen Medical College Agroha, Hisar (Haryana), a tertiary care center in North India. Demographic data, clinical presentation, ultrasonographic findings, cyst characteristics, management approach, operative details, and maternal and perinatal outcomes were analyzed. Comparisons between conservatively and surgically managed groups were performed using Chi-square/Fisher's exact test and Student's t-test as appropriate. Results The mean maternal age was 27.8 ± 4.6 years, and the majority of patients were diagnosed during the second trimester 55 (63.2%), predominantly through routine antenatal ultrasonography. The mean cyst size was 6.8 ± 2.7 cm, with torsion observed in 9 (10.3%) of cases. Conservative management was employed in 53 (60.9%), while 21 (24.1%) required antenatal surgery, predominantly laparoscopic cystectomy in the second trimester. Intraoperative complications were rare, and no malignant transformations were observed on histopathology. The mean gestational age at delivery was 38.1 weeks, with preterm birth in 14 (16.1%) of cases. Perinatal outcomes, including birth weight, NICU admission, and mortality, were comparable between conservatively and surgically managed groups. Conclusion Most dermoid cysts in pregnancy can be safely managed expectantly. When surgery is indicated, laparoscopic intervention during the second trimester is safe and associated with favorable maternal and fetal outcomes. These findings support a risk-stratified, individualized management approach, particularly relevant in resource-constrained settings.

【背景】類皮嚢腫(成熟嚢胞性奇形腫)は、生殖年齢女性で最も多い良性卵巣腫瘍であり、妊娠中にしばしば遭遇する。母体と胎児の安全性と手術リスクのバランスをとる必要があり、管理には独自の課題がある。インドの三次医療機関からのエビデンスは限られている。本研究は、妊娠中の類皮嚢腫の臨床像、管理戦略、母体・胎児転帰を評価することを目的とした。
【方法】インド北部ハリヤナ州のマハラジャ・アグラセン医科大学アグロハ校(三次医療機関)で、6年間に類皮嚢腫と診断された妊婦87例を対象とした後方視的観察研究を行った。人口統計学的データ、臨床症状、超音波所見、嚢腫の特徴、管理方法、手術の詳細、母体・周産期転帰を解析した。保存的管理群と手術群の比較には、カイ二乗検定/Fisher正確確率検定とStudentのt検定を適宜用いた。
【結果】平均母体年齢は27.8±4.6歳で、多くの患者(55例、63.2%)は妊娠中期に診断され、主に定期的な妊婦超音波検査で発見された。平均嚢腫径は6.8±2.7cmで、9例(10.3%)で捻転を認めた。保存的管理は53例(60.9%)に行われ、21例(24.1%)は妊娠中に手術を要し、主に妊娠中期の腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術であった。術中合併症はまれであった。病理組織学的検査で悪性転化は認めなかった。平均分娩週数は38.1週で、14例(16.1%)で早産であった。出生体重、NICU入院、死亡率を含む周産期転帰は、保存的管理群と手術群で同等であった。
【結論】妊娠中の類皮嚢腫の多くは待機的に安全に管理できる。手術が必要な場合、妊娠中期の腹腔鏡手術は安全で、母体・胎児の転帰も良好である。これらの知見は、特に資源が限られた地域において、リスク層別化と個別化された管理アプローチを支持するものである。
